utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive, Dane. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see where I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m a bit late, but I can help now. What’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane. We still need someone on sorting the donations and another pair of hands for hauling the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, can you tell me what time the repair drive starts?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring over a few extra tools and some tape if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that'd help a lot. Bring whatever you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll swing by with the tools and tape in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out, if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, but I should probably check what tools and supplies we actually need first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense. I can help once you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it starts at 9, but I’m not totally sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, I’ll be there at 9.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard they’re organizing the repair drive this afternoon. I’ll swing by and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and some clamps if they need them. I’ll bring them by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that’ll help a lot. I’ll tell them you’re bringing the drill and clamps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now - if you can help with the repair drive, swing by this evening and I’ll point you to the right table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’m putting Opal’s name on the list and I’ll make sure they know where to go when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the repair drive. What still needs attention?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the drive is still on and that nothing else needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the drive is still on, and I haven’t found anything else that needs fixing right now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’m matching volunteers to the urgent jobs first.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll help with the urgent ones.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. I’ll send you the urgent list and we can start with those repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll be ready too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have mixed up the time, but I can still help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, just let me know what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Just point me to the spot, and I’ll help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help out with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they still need someone to pick up the screws and check the back door latch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can grab the screws and take a look at the latch this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m putting together the repair drive invites now, Dane. I can swing by your place and tell the others too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll start spreading the word this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want to go over the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, what part of the repair drive do you want to go over?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can help with that after school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye. I’ll let the others know you can take that part after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I’ll be there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I can help get the repair drive moving if you want me to loop in the right people.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do that. Loop them in and I’ll keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll loop them in and keep an eye on the repair drive from here.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my toolbox by this afternoon and help out. Just point me to the first fix.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. Before you start, can you check whether the breaker’s tripped? I’m worried about the power first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check it first thing and then I’ll bring the toolbox over once we know what’s up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where things are headed. What do you need me to note about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Please note the addresses first, then the pickup date and any urgent repairs so I can keep the list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll note the addresses first, then the pickup date and any urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much longer do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: About an hour, if the next test goes clean. I’ll check the details once more before I call it done.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you give me a quick check when that next test starts?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly the wiring and a couple of broken fixtures still need attention. I can go over the parts I’ve got and see what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I can help with the wiring and fixtures. Let me know what parts you still need, and I’ll bring the rest.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m only getting this secondhand. What do I need to know?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think they’re collecting repairs for the block, but I missed the details. Best to ask at the community center if you want the sign-up info.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, I’ll check at the community center and see if they have the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess, you mean the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, I’ll see you there then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along. I can check on a couple more neighbors after I finish errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course. I’ll keep asking around and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I’m a little foggy on the details, but I’m in for the repair drive. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, meet me by the community center at 6. Bring gloves if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll be there at 6 with gloves if I can find them.
